name: gac
description: Git add and commit in one step, with shorthands that go further: /gacp pushes, /gacpp opens a PR, /gacppm merges it once CI passes. Works with GitHub and self-hosted Forgejo/Gitea, and sources nvm so Husky hooks run. /gac runs it.

author.name: WebDevNerdStuff & Bunnies... lots and lots of bunnies!
